rows.text: copies dword `+0x1F0` of `rcx` to `+0x1F4`; when qword `+0x10` is non-null, calls a 44-byte helper with that qword and then a 377-byte routine with a stack copy of the 16 bytes at `+0x60` as both `rcx` and `rdx` and takes the vector from that stack copy, otherwise takes the 16 bytes at `+0x60` unchanged; then moves the 16 bytes at `+0x70` to `+0x80` and stores the taken vector at `+0x70`; wrapped in the stack-cookie check (`01F44830`, `__security_check_cookie`)
